title: feat(spec): an agent's planning.maxIterations accepts up to 1000, a runaway fuse counted in model calls
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS7tTfwi2rUtUuTHh2paChXe)_
Fixes #37641

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/**` names an agent's `planning.maxIterations` or its bound (the only `maxIterations` a skill teaches is the flow loop node's, a different key)

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：写智能体时，推理轮数上限从最多 100 放宽到最多 1000，可以直接写 300。
- 为什么做：云端智能体效果专题第一阶段要把 ask 和 build 的轮数定为 300（你说的「为什么不直接 300」），原先写 300 会加载失败。
- 出错会怎样：只放宽、不收紧，以前能写的值现在照样能写；有问题直接撤回这一个改动即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts`: `AgentSchema.planning.maxIterations` goes from `int().min(1).max(100).default(10)` to `int().min(1).max(1000).default(10)`. The docblock and `.describe()` now say the value is a runaway fuse counted in model calls (one model call plus the tool batch it requests), not a quality knob, as the ruling asks.
- `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.form.ts`: the Studio form help text for `planning` stated "1–100"; it now says 1–1000 and the same fuse wording. This is a non-skills doc that states the bound, inside the order's file surface.
- `content/docs/references/ai/agent.mdx`: regenerated by `check:generated --fix` (one row: the new `.describe()` text). The JSON schema under `packages/spec/json-schema/` is gitignored and regenerates on build.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (11 locales): the same help text. `en` is regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`; the ten translated values stated "1–100" too and merge mode keeps translations as they are, so each is rewritten by hand to the new meaning and 1–1000. CI's `check:i18n` caught the `en` drift on the first head.
- One changeset: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/platform-objects` minor.

**Why 1000 and not unbounded.** The order offered 1000 or no upper bound. The value exists to stop a loop that would never end, so an upper bound keeps it a fuse: with no ceiling an author (or an AI writing metadata) can type `1000000` and switch the fuse off without anyone noticing. 1000 is more than three times the ruled 300 and twice open-agents' 500 (the epic's survey: Twenty 300, open-agents 500). LangGraph's 10000 is a recursion limit over graph supersteps, several of which make up one model call plus tool batch, so it is not the same unit. The published JSON schema keeps a `maximum`, so form renderers can still show the bound.

**Ruling** (not re-ruled): maintainer, 2026-11-26, 「为什么不直接 300」; triage 7198148430. `int().min(1)` is kept.

**Premise check** (objectstack `main` 87af66e5): `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts:418` read `z.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(10)` as the card says. Holds.

**Other readers that assumed 100 or less**, searched with `git grep -n maxIterations` and a bound-shaped grep over `skills/`, `content/docs/`, `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot`, `packages/services/service-ai*` and `packages/spec/src/ai` at 87af66e5:

| Reader | Assumes 100 or less? | Done |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.form.ts` help text "(1–100, default 10)" | yes | updated to 1–1000 |
| the help text's 11 translation bundles in `@objectstack/platform-objects` | yes | `en` regenerated, ten translations rewritten |
| `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.test.ts` "101 refused" case | yes | replaced (see Tests) |
| `content/docs/references/ai/agent.mdx` | prints `.describe()` only | regenerated |
| `packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts` `ChatWithToolsOptions.maxIterations` | no bound, "default: 10" | none needed |
| `ui/.../AgentPreview.tsx`, plugin-chatbot docs and tests | display or name the key only, no bound | none needed |
| flow `LoopConfig.maxIterations` and its docs, examples, skills row | a different key (`LOOP_MAX_ITERATIONS_CEILING`) | out of scope, untouched |
| `skills/**` | no skill states the agent bound | none needed, so no follow-up owed |
| cloud `service-ai` runtime (`AgentRuntime.loadAgent`, `DEFAULT_MAX_ITERATIONS`) | other repo | cloud#5029 declares 300 after this lands and the pin moves |

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/ai/agent.test.ts`, "Autonomous Reasoning": the old case that only asserted `toThrow()` for 0 and 101 is replaced by
- `accepts planning.maxIterations` for 1, 101, 300 and 1000: `safeParse` succeeds and the parsed value is the one written;
- `refuses planning.maxIterations` for 0 (`too_small`), 1001 (`too_big`) and 2.5 (`invalid_type`): exactly one issue, at path `['planning', 'maxIterations']`, with that code.

Reverse check: with the bound put back to `max(100)` on disk, the 101, 300 and 1000 accept cases go red (3 failed, 61 passed); restored from HEAD afterwards.

<details><summary>Local runs (heads 3b9712e2 and 0f2b4459)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/ai/agent.test.ts`: 64 passed (64).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 902 passed (902), Tests 28524 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` then `check:generated`: 1 of 14 stale (`content/docs/references/**`), fixed with `--fix`; `check:generated` then all up to date.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 112 derived families; 104 ran with exit 0. 8 are NOT MEASURED locally because a prerequisite was missing (exit 3: an unbuilt workspace package, or the shallow clone for one self-test), and CI runs them: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, `lint check:doc-formula-expressions`, `lint check:doc-security-posture`, `spec check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:lean-entry-closure`. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 112 accounted for, 104 run, 8 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- After the translation fix (0f2b4459): `pnpm check:i18n` exit 0 (all bundles in sync), `pnpm check:i18n-stale-fill` exit 0, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/apps/translations` 28 files, 625 tests passed; `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset` (all `--base origin/main`) and `check-nul-bytes` exit 0. The derived list for the new paths adds only `check:i18n-stale-fill`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The translated help texts are new wording by the author of this PR, not by a translator; a native-speaker pass is welcome.
- The `Clause-②:` line uses the closed arm `(widening)`; the order wrote the same meaning as free text ("widens the accepted range of a published schema key").
- No ADR-0087 entry: nothing an author wrote before is refused or changes meaning, so there is nothing to convert. Triage left it to review.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ai/agent.test.ts -t "maxIterations"` shows 7 passing cases, including `accepts planning.maxIterations 300`.

Read first: `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts` (the bound and docblock), then `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.test.ts` (the pins).
